title: Entity Kinetics
description: This mods adds motion-based damage, accelerating or decelerating will damage living entities, including the player.
body:
Entity Kinetics is a mod for adding Kinetic damage to both entities and the world.

All living entitie are able to receive damage by accelerating/decelerating fast enough.
such as hitting a wall at high speeds or launching yourself with tnt!

All blocks can be broken by colliding with them while moving fast enough.

All Living entities falling ontop of another applies damage.
